cohort: 131,094 women who gave birth in the last 5 years preceding the survey in 17 sub-Saharan African countries
finding: Approximately 42% of mothers practiced newborn skin-to-skin contact.
mod_finding: Women who delivered by caesarean section had lower odds of skin-to-skin contact (adjusted OR=0.15; 95% CI 0.13 to 0.16).
